column1: # Every bet actually placed, as a data file rather than prose.
# The bet log used to live in paragraphs, so every cross-cut of it was
# re-derived by hand — and one of them was re-derived wrong: `U3.5` off a
# `U3.0` tip was filed as a deviation for a whole day before the tier grouping
# showed it is the same bet. This file exists so buckets are computed from the
# engine's own numbers instead of from a label typed at the time.
# fixture   must match the fixture name in README.md's tables exactly; the
#           score, Tip 1 rung and Tip 1 probability are joined from there
# rung      the market ACTUALLY bought, which is often neither Tip 1 nor Tip 2
# side      H or A for a team total, - for a match total
# cashout   1 if the position was closed early; the ledger still scores the bet
#           as if held to full time, because that is what tests the tip. The
#           money actually taken differs and is not recorded by the bookmaker
Yokohama F. Marinos v Vissel Kobe
Santa Fe v América de Cali
